title: Nested-claim gate: agent token to P1 Privilege Agent App
lede: A mock PingFederate-style token reaches the P1 Privilege Agent App; the rule checks client_id and act.sub before the MCP server is called. Mock only. UNVERIFIED: that nested matching is new in gateway v1.261024.

steps.title: Agent asks for a token
steps.what: The agent authenticates to the mock identity provider as itself.

steps.title: Token carries act.sub
steps.what: The mapping puts the agent id in act as an OBJECT, {"sub": "{{castAgentId}}"}. The text "{}" would break the gate.

steps.title: Agent calls the app
steps.what: The agent presents the token to the P1 Privilege Agent App.

steps.title: Claims are flattened
steps.what: The token becomes dotted paths such as act.sub and client_id.

steps.title: Rule decides
steps.what: RequiredClaims client_id and act.sub must equal the registered agent. Anything else is denied.

steps.title: Allowed calls go through
steps.what: Only an allow reaches the MCP server.
